papers.title: Declarative Attention: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
papers.authors: Ho, Ahmad, Koh, Yun, Schuster, dos Santos (KAIST AI)
papers.what: Lets a model declare inside its chain of thought which context region it needs, so the inference engine can skip most of the KV cache read, cutting attended tokens during decoding by 52.0 percent on Gemma-4-31B and 31.1 percent on Qwen-3.6-27B for accuracy costs of 1.27 and 2.75 percentage points across 15 long-context tasks, zero-shot and with no retraining.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); Chain-of-Thought Prompting (Wei 2023, HBLPTRMY); DeepSeek-V3 (2024, 2JCKA7GI)

papers.title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
papers.authors: Chen, Hu, Qian, Liu, Wei et al. (BAAI)
papers.what: Names operational knowledge as the layer missing from research agents and distills it from 1,000 repositories into 5,000-plus verified skills, lifting a fixed-backbone fixed-harness agent by 134.3 percent on MLE-bench, 34.4 percent on PaperBench, 9.2 percent on FrontierCS and 14.0 percent on PassNet.
papers.builds_on: ToolkenGPT (Hao 2024, 6RDHVVA2); Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU)

papers.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.authors: Huang, Fang, Qian, Kong, Zhao et al. (CUHK-Shenzhen)
papers.what: Converts 1.43 million clips from 10 datasets into one frame-aligned data contract so the training mixture becomes an experimental variable, then trains four 5B to 33B models on three video backbones under a shared three-stage recipe, reaching real-time rollouts of minutes to hours from 5-second training clips without long-sequence fine-tuning or attention sinks.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT); Navigation World Models (Bar 2024, JQ7JD8AR); DINO-WM (Zhou 2025, W44RSJJI)

papers.title: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
papers.authors: Shi, Sun, Dong, Wan, Lo, Gu (SJTU, SMU)
papers.what: Halts agent benchmark runs once a pair of calibrated LightGBM success and failure classifiers reads the outcome from intermediate behaviour, removing 13 to 26 percent of steps and up to 44.1 percent of input tokens at 89 to 97 percent accuracy while moving resolve rates by one to two percentage points.
papers.builds_on: Evaluating World Models (Vafa 2024, P92FLHJ2); Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU)
